capabilities: Apply full Mermaid theme objects to diagrams
Merge partial theme customizations with a base theme
Render themed diagrams from a merm code fence
disambiguation: Not an Obsidian appearance theme; it only changes how Mermaid diagrams render, not the app's look.
extras: Supported by advertisements. Must use the merm code fence label since mermaid is reserved. Install via BRAT until listed in community plugins; the README says bugs should be reported as issues.
intentEvidence: This project allows the user to easily apply and customize themes to mermaid.js diagrams in obsidian.
motivation: The author discovered Mermaid through the Markdown Confluence plugin and built this to make diagram theming easy.
problem: Mermaid diagrams in Obsidian render with the default theme and offer no built-in way to customize their colors and styling.

relations.evidence: It was inspired by the awesome new plugin for publishing your note content to Confluence.
you can install it as a beta tester using the BRAT plugin

summary: Applies custom Mermaid.js theme objects to diagrams in notes via a merm code fence, merging your settings with a base theme.
